none: PAS FindID 957576: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left, trident over left shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 1.39gms, die axis: 6
